VghLantern__LandingScreen__Config__Descr: System configuration overlay for the landing screen shown when the application initialises. Merged over VghLantern__AppConfig__Main__.json by the ConfigLoader, so read every value through StateManager.VghLantern__StateManager__GetAppConfig() rather than fetching this file directly. The greeting writes itself character by character with the signed in user's name; every tab stays greyed until the user leaves via View Project Library or Create New Project.

VghLantern__LandingScreen__Config__Conte.GreetingTemplateNote: {UserName} is replaced with the signed in user's display name. The greeting stays empty until a user exists, because the login gate covers the landing screen up to that moment.
VghLantern__LandingScreen__Config__Conte.VersionLabelNote: {AppVersion} is replaced with VghLantern__Application__Config__AppVersion so the landing card can never disagree with the config SSOT.
VghLantern__LandingScreen__Config__Conte.CopyrightText: © 2026 Vale Garden Houses | All Rights Reserved

VghLantern__LandingScreen__Config__Behav.TypewriterCharDelayNote: Per character delay of the greeting write-on. Around 38ms reads as handwriting pace; 0 renders the line instantly for impatient demos.
VghLantern__LandingScreen__Config__Behav.CaretSettleDelayNote: How long the caret keeps blinking after the line completes before it fades out.
